A '''community''' was located on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] near [[Lake Sah'ot]]. It was visited by medical officer [[Zahara Cody]] and former prisoner [[Trig Longo]] after they escaped from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Prison ship/Legends|prison barge]] ''[[Purge]]''.<ref name="DT" />
